name: line/hw-underline
title: Hand-drawn underline / strike / bracket
title_vi: Gạch chân, gạch bỏ, ngoặc vẽ tay
desc_vi: Nét vẽ tay (gạch chân lượn sóng, gạch bỏ hai nét hoặc ngoặc) tự vẽ ra trên chữ rồi rung nhẹ như vẽ tay; ra bằng mờ dần.
params_vi: style: underline | strike | bracket · left, top, width, height: khung đặt đè lên chữ (px) · seed: kiểu nét (mỗi nét một seed khác nhau) · color, strokeWidth · drawTime (0.55 s) · boil: bật rung, boilAmp/boilRot: biên độ · exitAt: giây ra (null = không ra)
notes: Path maths (hwMarkPath incl. the sin-hash wobble), draw (strokeDashoffset len -> 0, 0.55 s, power2.inOut) and fade-off (0.3 s, power2.in) are as in the source; the dash length is measured once at build with getTotalLength() and written as a number (rounded up to 0.01), path coordinates are rounded to 3 decimals. The source handwriting font (Caveat) is not shipped: the demo text uses the film's font. Boil (hwBoil) = per-frame x/y/rotation from a hash of floor(time*30/frameDrop): a ctx.code proxy tween (hence ae: expression), time counted from `at` of the mark, element index = the order of marks in the film (as the source's list index), +1e-6 added before floor() so frame boundaries do not depend on float noise; it runs for exitAt + 0.3 s (10 s if there is no exit). The source runs the boil on the whole timeline: no visible difference because the mark is hidden outside its life. The mark is hidden before `at` (source: dash hides it). Colour default = the source fallback --hw-accent-warm #ffb020. Give each mark in a film its own `seed`.
